node.statement: Triangle step: for e<=e_0:=min(e_u,e_act,e_co), the identity ((Ha^Q_{P,P})_n(U)-I)X=((Ha^Q_{P,P})_n(U)X-U dot X)+(U dot X-X), followed by the triangle inequality for q_P and the preceding estimates, gives q_P(((Ha^Q_{P,P})_n(U)-I)X)<=(C_act*K_u+C_co)*e*q_P(X).
